title: provider-presets.v1
description: Named presets for OpenAI-compatible endpoints. A preset records where a vendor documents such an endpoint; it never asserts that the vendor's API was contacted or works.

jurisdiction.description: The vendor's stated corporate jurisdiction as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, or not_applicable for a local endpoint. Attested, never checked.

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the key. Never the key.

compatibility.description: documented: the vendor documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. partial: known divergence, described in notes.

review.description: unreviewed: base_url not yet confirmed against docs_url in this repository's history. reviewed: confirmed against the documentation only, never against the live API.
